_readme: Edit the values below, then redeploy. Text keys match data-edit attributes in index.html. Leave a link empty to hide it.

text.hero.kicker: Brand hub for partners, makers and the team
text.logo.title: The sun, hidden in plain sight.
text.logo.body: Softened junctions, room to breathe around the O, and a floating accent above the È as a quiet point of light. Three marks, each in Black and Paper.
text.colour.title: Warm, faded, never neon.
text.colour.body: Paper and Black lead every layout; each pillar adds one pair, as whole fields, never tints or gradients. Select a value to copy it.
text.type.title: Two typefaces. One scale.
text.type.body: Serif for voice and titles, grotesk for labels and structure. Hierarchy comes from position and whitespace, not from more sizes.
text.art.title: Light is the protagonist.
text.art.body: Shadows, squints and hard sun carry the presence of the sun without ever showing it. Real skin, film warmth, the product worn rather than posed.
text.tpl.title: Six layouts, one grid.
text.tpl.body: Every page sits on a 4 × 4 grid with columns at 23, 521, 997 and 1458, and one header line at the top.
text.labels.title: The quiet details.
text.labels.body: Logo-free on the outside, considered on the inside. First concepts for production review; sizes and suppliers to be confirmed.
text.hats.title: UPF 50+ protected collections.
text.hats.body: Two lines today, a third to come. Clean, minimal and logo-free, with UPF 50+ protection built into the fabric.
text.dl.title: The asset library.
text.dl.body: Master logos, fonts, photography and templates live in one Google Drive folder. Download them here, or open the full folder.
